question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
-- Final query using income_group to filter real countries
WITH pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    year_2017 AS pop_2017,
    year_2018 AS pop_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND year_2017 > 0 AND year_2018 > 0
),
health_2017 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS he_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2017
),
health_2018 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS he_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2018
),
country_list AS (
  SELECT country_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.country_summary`
  WHERE income_group IS NOT NULL AND income_group != ''
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    p.country_code,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p.pop_2018 - p.pop_2017, p.pop_2017) * 100 AS pop_pct_change,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(h2.he_2018 - h1.he_2017, h1.he_2017) * 100 AS he_pct_change
  FROM pop p
  INNER JOIN health_2017 h1 ON p.country_code = h1.country_code
  INNER JOIN health_2018 h2 ON p.country_code = h2.country_code
  INNER JOIN country_list cl ON p.country_code = cl.country_code
  WHERE h1.he_2017 IS NOT NULL AND h2.he_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND h1.he_2017 > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM joined
WHERE pop_pct_change > 1 
  AND he_pct_change > 1
